package: CR-090 / admin-coverage A11 — administrators must use a second factor (platform policy)
tree: worktree claude/agent-billing on 65bf805, CR-090 changes uncommitted at verification time

contract.setting: meta key security.admin_second_factor ∈ {off, required}; default off keeps the standing rule (sessions.admin_capable)
contract.rule: synwevo_core.platform_access.admin_session_shortfall: one_factor (standing rule) or second_factor (policy): under 'required' a platform administrator's session must carry two distinct factor kinds or a user-verified passkey ceremony; the password re-entered proves nothing new; require_platform answers 403 step_up_required with detail {policy: admin_second_factor, second_factor_enrolled}; /api/auth/me carries admin_lock {reason, second_factor_enrolled}; /api/admin/session step_up carries reason/policy/second_factor_enrolled
contract.routes: GET /api/admin/security/second-factor (platform.config.view) and POST (platform.config.manage, strict re-authentication, reason, expected_mode); requiring is refused with 409 no_second_factor_admin while no usable super administrator has a TOTP app or a user-verified passkey enrolled, so the policy can never lock every administrator out; audit admin.security.second_factor
contract.scope: platform administration only — the person keeps their account and enrols there; 'all users' and per-organization requirements are not offered; no grace period (the lock applies at once and ends with a passkey confirmation or a sign-in with the code)
